effect.black-white: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
effect.black-2-white-2: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

short_effect.black-white: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.
short_effect.black-2-white-2: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.

flavor_text.black-white: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit with Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
flavor_text.black-2-white-2: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit with Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.
